read-ai-alternative.4: Read AI costs $15 to $29.75 per user per month on annual billing, and most Read AI competitors sit in a similar band: Fireflies Pro at $10, Granola Business at $14, Lynkk at $15.
read-ai-alternative.8: Lynkk supports 17 languages plus auto-detect, including Hindi and Hinglish, and lets teams pin their data to the US, EU, UK, India, Singapore or Australia. Free covers 5 notes a month. Pro? $15 a month.
read-ai-alternative.10: Fireflies pushes call notes into CRMs and offers search across every call, at $10 per seat billed yearly for Pro and $19 for Business. Watch for storage limits on lower tiers. Some AI features also use credits.
read-ai-alternative.12: No bot ever joins: Granola captures audio from your device and turns your rough typed notes into full ones, with Business at $14 per user per month and its limits covered in our [Granola AI alternatives guide](https://lynkk.ai/blog/granola-ai-alternatives).
read-ai-alternative.13: Jamie records without a bot, hosts data in the EU and lists 99+ languages, while its free tier allows 10 notes a month at up to 30 minutes each. Team? $37 per seat billed yearly.
read-ai-alternative.21: Read AI's top tier, Enterprise+ ($29.75 billed yearly), adds SAML, SCIM, domain capture, HIPAA compliance and custom retention, yet most concerns are less about security than about control. Who can send the notetaker into a meeting?
read-ai-alternative.29: Read AI's main competitors are Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Fathom, Granola, tl;dv, Jamie and Lynkk, and their approaches differ, from live transcription to bot-free notes to automated follow-up. Compare on free limits, price per user, privacy controls and what happens after the meeting.
read-ai-alternative.31: Yes, Lynkk supports Hindi and has a Hinglish setting for conversations that mix Hindi and English. Read AI lists 20+ languages. Check that list against what your team speaks, then test any tool on a real meeting in each of those languages before you roll it out.
